text:
anya: Holiday cheer chain! 🎉 Let's do a tiny non-work thing — post a festive photo or gif, send a 1-line holiday wish, then tag one person to keep it going. I'll start: my cactus finally has a tiny santa hat. :santa: Good vibes to everyone!

sam: omg cactus santa pls pic pls :joy: 

anya: (pic) tiny hat; it looks judging. happy holidays y'all — tag @jordyn! :snowflake:

jordyn: love it 😂 here's a terrible holiday playlist i made: https://tiny.example/ugly-jams add your fav! Happy low-key holidays to the crew. Tagging @mike

mike: sending a mug shot of my peppermint hot choc. also volunteering to bring a thermos to the office snack table next Wed 3pm. anyone want marshmallows? :hot_chocolate: :marshmallow:

claudia: marshmallows yes pls. also i'm starting a 5-cookie-limit policy at my desk (for my own good). warming up for the gingerbread desk challenge. tag @anya back to you for next cheer! :cookie:

anya: 5-cookie-limit noted and immediately violated in spirit :eyes: big kudos to everyone doing small social things this week. hr-bot, can we get a tiny non-mandatory holiday zoom hangout link?

hr-bot: FYI — "Holiday Coffee & Cheer" optional hangout scheduled Thu 4pm PT, Zoom link posted in #random-calendar. No forced caroling. :calendar:

sam: perfect. bringing my famous (or infamous) eggnog recipe to the virtual table. tag @claudia to keep the chain going!

claudia: posting my plant-in-a-scarf pic in 3...2...1... :evergreen_tree: Happy everything. tagging @jordyn to continue the cheer chain! :sparkles:

jordyn: here's a dumb holiday meme (gif). sending warm fuzzy vibes to the infra team who are probably still awake 🙏 :heart: Tagging @mike — pass it on!

mike: passing it along — dropping off hot chocolate at the 3rd floor lounge at 3pm tomorrow for anyone popping by. huge thanks for the good vibes, team. :tada:
